name: Shire of Dardanup council data centre consolidation
notes: DCD reported the Shires of Dardanup, Harvey, and Donnybrook/Balingup adopted XenSource in their data centers to consolidate Linux and Windows terminal servers and improve business continuity; this appears to be council IT infrastructure rather than a public colocation or hyperscale facility.

name: Shire of Donnybrook-Balingup council data centre consolidation
notes: DCD reported the Shires of Dardanup, Harvey, and Donnybrook/Balingup adopted XenSource in their data centers for server consolidation and business continuity; this appears to be council IT infrastructure rather than a public colocation or hyperscale facility.

name: Western Green Energy Hub data centres
developer: Western Green Energy Hub consortium / InterContinental Energy / CWP Global / Mirning Green Energy
notes: Official environmental referral material describes a proposed large-scale wind/solar/hydrogen project in the Shire of Dundas and City of Kalgoorlie-Boulder with centrally-sited data centres alongside electrolysers and electrical, pumping, and cooling infrastructure. Data-centre IT load has not been disclosed separately.

name: NEXTDC NE1 Newman Data Centre
notes: NEXTDC lists NE1 Newman at Cnr Pardoo St and Woodstock St, Newman, as a Tier III certified edge data centre serving Pilbara mining and resources workloads. NDY says full build-out includes 560 m2 technical space, 1.5 MW IT capacity and 250+ racks; completion is listed as 2024.
